name: camphor (synthetic) + menthol + petrolatum + phenol
purpose: Purpose Cold sore/fever blister treatment Skin Protectant
uses: Uses • For treatment of cold sores/fever blisters on the face or lips • Temporarily relieves the symptoms of itching and pain associated with cold sores/fever blisters • Temporarily protects minor cuts, scrapes, burns, and sores • Helps prevent and temporarily protects chapped or cracked skin and lips
otcwarn: Stop use and consult a doctor if the condition persists or gets worse. Do not use longer than 1 week unless directed by a doctor.
